name: sparkline
title: Sparkline
description: A tiny inline trend line for a table cell or a sentence.
a11y: role=img with the required title as its name.
A visually hidden table (table roles on spans, valid inside a paragraph) lists every value for screen readers.
Decorative at a glance: it has no tooltip and no tab stops.

props.name: data
props.description: Values in order. Non-finite values count as 0.

props.name: labels
props.description: Names for the values, used in the screen reader table. Default: 1, 2, 3...

props.name: valueFormat
props.description: Format a value for the screen reader table.

usage:
import {Sparkline} from '@monoline/react';
